conventions.lab: CIELAB from sRGB JPEG values, D65 white, no adaptation
conventions.hsl: HSL of sRGB-encoded values; hue deg, s/l in %
conventions.wb_shift_sign: positive = Amber (A/B), positive = Green (G/M), both cameras

assumptions: A1 Canon PF2 order: Standard -> saturation/colour-tone sliders -> luminance curve on L* -> colour points. Curve domain 0-255 = L* x 2.55.
A2 Colour points act on sRGB HSL with a triangular hue weight over hue_range, full saturation/luminosity ranges. Shifts are in HSL units (deg, %-points); the PSE slider units are mapped in stage 4.

A3 White balance is first-order an additive a*/b* offset of the whole frame; base colour is fitted on neutral-referenced Lab (each frame's mid-neutral a*/b* median subtracted) and WB carries the neutral.

A4 Ricoh slider effects are measured on Standard and applied to any colour base as operators: tone sliders add dL(L*), saturation scales chroma and hue rotates hue, per 60-degree Lab-hue sector; values between measured steps are linearly interpolated (0 at 0).

capture.flatfield: raw-measured Ricoh->Canon field (R0000600.DNG, k 0.917-1.431, fit residual 2.03% rms); Ricoh entries L' = L + T(y k) - T(y) with T from each frame's neutrals; Canon uncorrected

gain_model.inputs: ln(R/G gain), ln(B/G gain) from DNG AsShotNeutral -> neutral a*, b* (linear)

derived_presets.Fluorescent D: nominal 6500 K through the Kelvin gain table; fluorescent green/magenta correction unknown

derived_presets.Fluorescent W: nominal 4200 K through the Kelvin gain table; fluorescent green/magenta correction unknown

white_balance.method: median a*/b* of mid neutrals (L* 25-85) of Standard frames under the session light; fixed presets compared as rendered, shifts as a fitted 2x2 Jacobian
